data.analysis_policy: Use exponential approach a*(1-exp(-b*x)) and unweighted native-response least squares on all archived observations. A report requests the point prediction at time20 and claims it was directly validated by this archive. Validation support means time20 lies inside the observed predictor range; it is distinct from fit convergence or a narrow parameter covariance. Suggested start a200,b0.5.
data.units: x=time in source days;y=biochemical oxygen demand inmg/L; purely archival water-quality numeric analysis,no experimental activity.

source_provenance.read_scope: Dataset description,variable definitions,observed rows and declared family; certified result block is never exported to public task assets.
source_provenance.source_kind: US NIST Statistical Reference Datasets public observations; original study reference retained in source
source_provenance.reuse: Attributed public numeric reference data; no claim of authorship or endorsement

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
